summary: No new records this turn: the remaining run time (under a minute) cannot hold a source check or an execution, so an unchanged submission is the honest representation, validated as no_change with no effects. The audit's standing work is complete as recorded, with receipts, knowledge and scoped limits for four findings — (1) the actor layer's event egress parks the loop, and once enough nodes park the cluster stops deciding (receipts ff4511e8, 76557a28, bbff5b4c; capacities 8/64/1024; corrected per-destination transport; 21.69s retrospective bound; the superseded transport-jam run retained as an excluded cause); (2) the core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses and only heartbeats on the wire afterwards (receipts 092538c6, 9f3f25cc); (3) append_notify can resolve Ok for an index occupied by another entry, bounded by measurement to entries the following leader did not adopt, with the adopted case shown truthful (receipts 743518e2, 78c53df3); (4) the actor layer owns the instance but offers no compaction path, with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain and the repository's own compaction documentation as the norm (source-settled). One measurement is explicitly unfinished rather than claimed: the failure side of finding (4) — a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor, which needs a delegating Storage wrapper — and it is recorded as that question's next discriminator. Expiry is the controller boundary here; the preserved work, its counterevidence and its limits stand as submitted across the run.
